ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a plan view from above of a gray school corridor. The corridor is composed of a lower horizontal section, a middle vertical connecting section, and an upper horizontal section. A dashed line is drawn in the middle of the corridor, representing the centerline walked by the cat. The figure marks the lower corridor width as 8 m, the lower outer horizontal length as 40 m, the horizontal distance from the left end to the left side of the vertical connecting section as 36 m; the upper corridor width as 6 m, the upper outer horizontal length as 28 m; and in the vertical direction, the distance to the lower edge of the upper corridor is marked as 20 m. Reasoning: Calculate in three sections according to the dashed centerline. The width of the vertical connecting section is obtained from 40−36=4 m, so the centerline is 2 m from each side of the connecting section. The length of the lower horizontal centerline is 36+2=38 m. The length of the vertical centerline is 20−8/2+6/2=20−4+3=19 m. The length of the upper horizontal centerline is 28−2=26 m. The total distance is 38+19+26=83 m.

raw_record.question_text: From above, the corridor of a school looks like in the diagram. A cat walks along the dotted line drawn in the middle of the room. How many meters does the cat walk?

method.method_draft: Treat the dotted path as the corridor centerline made of three straight orthogonal pieces. From the image, read the lower corridor height as 8 m, the lower outside horizontal length as 40 m, the distance from the left end to the left side of the vertical connector as 36 m, the top corridor height as 6 m, the top outside horizontal length as 28 m, and the vertical distance up to the underside of the top corridor as 20 m. Infer the connector width as 40−36=4 m, so its center is 2 m from either side. Then compute the centerline pieces: lower horizontal = 36+2=38 m; vertical = 20−(8/2)+(6/2)=19 m; upper horizontal = 28−2=26 m. Add them: 38+19+26=83 m.

推理：按照虚线中心线分成三段计算。竖直连接段的宽度由 40−36=4 m 得到，所以中心线距离连接段两侧各 2 m。下方水平中心线长度为 36+2=38 m。竖直中心线长度为 20−8/2+6/2=20−4+3=19 m。上方水平中心线长度为 28−2=26 m。总路程为 38+19+26=83 m。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply the geometric rule that a centerline in a corridor lies halfway between the walls, so endpoint/turn distances must be adjusted by half the relevant corridor widths before summing straight path segments.
